Vagus

Release notes

What changed in each version of Vagus, newest first.

Version 1.0.0

October 29, 2026
  • First release on Google Play. Thanks for testing!
  • Filter Artists, Inbox and Catalogue by tier, tag, genre and release type. Tap a filter twice to exclude it.
  • Genres are grouped into families like Rock, Jazz and Hip-Hop.
  • Artist search shows artists you follow, listen to, or that sound like them first, and says why.
  • Swipe the Artists list sideways to switch tiers.
  • Make a playlist from the Inbox, the Catalogue or any artist's page. The playlist file includes each song's exact recording code, so songs with common titles land on the right version.
  • Choose which tiers and tags send you notifications.
  • Import artists from Apple Music and other playlists through TuneMyMusic.
  • New release notifications show album art.
  • Artists that showed a blank picture now get their photo from Spotify.
  • Delete your account from Settings.
